art_direction: 炭黑冰瞳 · 挑眼怀疑: 炭黑底，冰蓝色一睁一眯的疑惑眼神。
composition_variation: Matte charcoal-black field #151515. Pale glacier-blue iris bands and off-white catchlights only. No eyebrows: express raised-eyebrow mood entirely with eyelid shapes. Eyes at mid-height have different tilts, not mirrored. No mouth, nose, fur or other marks. Huge black pupils merge into background.
